0022600115.text: Both teams come in 2-0, with the Toronto Raptors (2nd in the Atlantic, 3rd in the East) visiting the Minnesota Timberwolves (3rd in the Northwest, 6th in the West). Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), while Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Raptors lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 115-107 defeat in Minneapolis on March 5.
